notes: Declarative validation rules (Appendix B). The engine reads this file; `check` names the implemented check and `settings` carries the thresholds. Changing a GST rule is a pack version bump, not an engine release.

severity_model.auto_post_rule: Any fail blocks auto-post. A warn lowers confidence and may route to review depending on tenant thresholds.

rules.title: GSTIN format
rules.description: 15 characters, valid state code, PAN pattern, and checksum character.

breach.fail: GSTIN is not a valid 15-character GSTIN.

rules.title: GSTIN active status
rules.description: Vendor GSTIN is active and not cancelled or suspended, via GSTN APIs.

breach.fail: GSTIN is cancelled or suspended at the GSTN.
breach.warn: GSTIN status could not be checked right now; the record will be rechecked.

rules.title: Tax type versus place of supply
rules.description: CGST and SGST used for intra-state, IGST for inter-state, based on vendor state and place of supply.

breach.fail: Tax split does not match the place of supply.
breach.warn: Place of supply could not be established; assuming intra-state.

rules.title: Tax arithmetic
rules.description: Taxable value times rate equals tax amount per line, within a rounding tolerance.

breach.fail: Tax amount does not match the taxable value at the stated rate.
breach.warn: Tax amount is off by a small rounding amount.

rules.title: Total arithmetic
rules.description: Line totals plus taxes plus round-off equal the invoice total.

breach.fail: Invoice total differs from the sum of its parts.

rules.title: HSN and rate check
rules.description: HSN code is valid and the GST rate matches the expected rate for that HSN.

breach.warn: HSN or GST rate does not match the expected rate for this code.

rules.title: Duplicate invoice
rules.description: Same vendor and invoice number, or near-identical content found by similarity search.

breach.fail: The same vendor and invoice number has already been recorded.
breach.warn: A near-identical document was recorded earlier.

rules.title: Three-way match
rules.description: Invoice quantity and rate agree with the purchase order and goods receipt within tolerance.

breach.warn: Invoice does not agree with the purchase order or goods receipt.
breach.fail: Invoice differs from the purchase order or goods receipt by more than the allowed variance.

rules.title: GSTR-2B match
rules.description: Invoice appears in the vendor's filed return with matching value and tax, so input credit risk is visible.

breach.warn: Invoice is not visible in the vendor's filed return for this period; input credit is at risk.

rules.title: E-invoice IRN
rules.description: Where e-invoicing applies, the IRN is present and consistent with the invoice details.

breach.fail: E-invoicing applies to this vendor but no valid IRN is present.
breach.warn: IRN is present but does not clearly match the invoice details.

rules.title: E-way bill consistency
rules.description: Where applicable, e-way bill value, GSTINs and document number match the invoice.

breach.warn: E-way bill does not match the invoice on value, GSTIN or document number.

rules.title: TDS applicability
rules.description: Vendor category and amount suggest TDS, and the section and rate are captured.

breach.warn: TDS may apply to this payment but the section and rate are not captured.

rules.title: Date sanity
rules.description: Invoice date is not in the future and falls within an open financial period.

breach.fail: Document date is in the future or outside an open financial period.

rules.title: Bank running balance
rules.description: Each statement line's balance agrees with the previous balance plus or minus the movement.

breach.warn: Statement balance does not agree with the previous line.

rules.title: Bank line categorisation and ledger match
rules.description: Categorise the line and match it to an open bill or a known ledger.

breach.warn: No confident ledger or open bill match for this line.
